entry.content: primitive.average_entry: description +Edge cases: symbol non-empty; at least one fill, each price and quantity above zero (size is accepted as quantity); leverage above zero is optional. Not covered: fees, sells or partial closes (give only the fills still open), and funding. primitive.hedge_ratio: description +Edge cases: spotSize above zero (USD value); hedgeRatio 0 to 200 percent (default 100); leverage 1 or more (default 1); fundingRatePct in percent per interval (0.01 is 0.01%, default 0.01); intervalHours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); an inverse contract needs entryPrice. Not covered: basis risk between spot and the perp, rebalancing as prices move, margin calls, and a funding rate that changes. workflow.run_american_option: description +Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry (at most 3650) and volatilityPct (at most 300) above zero; steps a whole number from 50 to 2000; when the rate and the dividend yield are too far apart for the volatility and expiry the tree is invalid and the call is an error that says so; numbers that overflow are an error. The price is a tree value, close to the exact one but not equal to it (see treeError). Not covered: discrete dividends, a volatility smile, negative rates, taxes, margin, transaction costs, and exercise limited to certain dates (Bermudan). workflow.run_apy_apr_converter: description +Edge cases: rate a fraction from -periodsPerYear (APR) or above -1 (APY) up to 1000; give periodsPerYear (1 to 365) or continuous true, never both and never neither; the rate per period must stay above -100%; a continuous APR above 709 (70,900%) is an error. Not covered: fees, token price moves, a pool rate that changes, taxes, and compounding that is not regular. workflow.run_average_down: description +Edge cases: all prices, sizes, stop_loss and leverage above zero; fee_open_pct and fee_close_pct are fractions from 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005); mmr 0 to 0.2; for a long the stop must be below the add price and for a short above it, otherwise an error (a stop that price already reached means the position should be closed). The risk comparison is meaningful only when the add is at a worse price than the existing entry. Not covered: funding, slippage, a stop that gaps through, and whether the market will recover. workflow.run_barrier_touch: description +Edge cases: spot, barrier and daysToExpiry (at most 3650) above zero; volatilityPct 0.01 to 1000; driftPct -1000 to 1000; barrier and spot must be within a factor of about 5e8 of each other. Not covered: a discrete-monitored barrier, knock-in or knock-out option prices, jumps, volatility that changes over time, trading costs; the probability is under a constant volatility and drift. workflow.run_black_scholes: description +Assumptions: European exercise only, one flat volatility for the whole life (no smile or skew), constant rate and dividend yield, a year of 365 calendar days, theta per calendar day. Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry and volatilityPct must be above zero; riskFreeRatePct and dividendYieldPct must be between 0 and 100, so a negative rate is refused; a deep out-of-the-money option returns a price and Greeks of exactly 0, and a very low volatility or very short expiry gives a very large gamma and theta, not an error. Not covered: early exercise (use workflow.run_american_option), discrete di workflow.run_black_scholes_live: description +Edge cases: European Black-Scholes on the venue mark IV with one flat volatility; an expired instrument, a missing or zero mark IV, an invalid underlying price or a mark price of 0 returns available false with the reason, never a number (every numeric field is then null); riskFreeRatePct 0 to 100 applies to Deribit only (Binance states its own rate, Bybit prices off a forward with none). Not covered: early exercise, discrete dividends, skew, bid-ask spread and Greeks adjusted for coin settlement. workflow.run_bond_price: description +Edge cases: faceValue above zero and at most 1e12 (default 1000); couponRate 0 to 1 as a fraction; yieldRate -1 to 100 with the rate per period above -100%; years above zero and at most 100; frequency a whole number 1 to 12 (default 2); years times frequency must be a whole number of coupon periods. Not covered: accrued interest and a settlement date between coupons, credit risk, call and put features, floating coupons, taxes, and the day-count convention. workflow.run_bonding_curve: description +Edge cases: solRaisedSoFar from 0 up to the graduation amount (a graduated token is out of range); solToSpend above zero. Pure constant-product math with pump.fun virtual-reserve constants, no live lookup. Not covered: the pump.fun trading fee unless stated in the result, slippage from other buyers landing first, tokens that already graduated to a real pool, and other launchpads with a different curve. workflow.run_breakeven_planning: description +Edge cases: entryPrice and sizeBase above zero; feeOpenPct and feeClosePct fractions from 0 to 0.05 (defaults 0.0002 and 0.0005). Fees only. Not covered: funding (use workflow.run_funding_breakeven), slippage and spread. workflow.run_breakout_acceptance: description +Edge cases: instrument non-empty and venue binance or bybit; session_date is a completed UTC session before today; timeframe 1m, 5m, 15m or 30m (default 15m); value_area_rule 0.5 to 0.9 (default 0.70); supplied candles must each have high at or above low, open and close, low at or below them, and volume 0 or more; a session with no candles is an error. include_delta true or false (default true). Not covered: contributions or withdrawals in between (that is not CAGR), the path and volatility between the two dates, and any forecast; CAGR smooths a bumpy path into one rate. workflow.run_carry_trade: description, inputSchema +Edge cases: notional and hold_days above zero; funding_rate_long and funding_rate_short are in PERCENT per interval (0.01 means 0.01%), either sign; transfer_fee_pct 0 or more, one way (default 0.1); interval_hours 0.25 to 24 (default 8), one interval for both legs. Not covered: a fractional contract, and (already stated) commissions, early assignment, taxes, dividends and interest on the cash. workflow.run_cointegration: description +Edge cases: x and y each at least 20 values and the same length, one observation per date (otherwise an error); constant residuals (zero variance) are an error; the test is one direction (y regressed on x), Engle-Granger. Not covered: the identifiers being the same bet and resolving the same way (you confirm that), order book depth and slippage, withdrawal and deposit costs, settlement-rule differences, and capital lock-up until resolution. workflow.run_crypto_profit: description +Edge cases: buyPrice and sellPrice above zero; give exactly one of investment (above zero, buy fee included) or quantity (above zero); buyFeePct and sellFeePct are fractions from 0 to 0.05 (default 0); holdingDays optional, annualized return only from 30 days. Spot only. Not covered: choosing the event window or the placebo set (the result is only as good as that choice), overlapping events, clustering in time, and causality. workflow.run_evt_tail_risk: description +Edge cases: at least 100 finite returns; threshold_percentile strictly between 0 and 100 (default 90); confidence strictly between 0 and 1 (default 0.99); at least 10 returns beyond the threshold, otherwise an error; if the tail fit does not converge, the call is an error suggesting another threshold. Not covered: bank or broker markups, fees, rounding rules of a particular provider, and the direction of the rate (you must supply the rate that applies from the first to the second currency). workflow.run_forex_currency_converter_live: description +Edge cases: amount may be zero or negative (converted as given); from and to are ISO 4217 codes; the same currency on both sides returns the amount with source identity; no rate found gives available false and no figure. The rate is a TrueFX tick or a daily ECB reference rate, not a dealer quote. Not covered: broker markups and fractional pips. workflow.run_forex_pnl: description +Edge cases: entryPrice, exitPrice and units above zero; The pair is BASE/QUOTE with two different ISO 4217 currency codes, in any letter case; crypto tickers and precious metals (XAU, XAG, XPT, XPD) are refused. Not covered: price divergence between the venues, liquidation of either leg, margin on both venues, a rate that changes during the hold, and trading fees. workflow.run_funding_breakeven: description +Edge cases: entry_price, size and hold_hours above zero; funding_rate is a decimal per funding interval (0.0001 is 0.01%), either sign; funding_interval_hours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); fees are fractions from 0 to 0.05. Not covered: a funding rate that changes during the hold, mark versus last price, and slippage. workflow.run_funding_cost: description +Edge cases: sizeBase, entryPrice and days above zero; fundingRate a fraction per interval (0.0001 is 0.01%), either sign; intervalHours 0.25 to 24 (default 8); if funding exceeds the position notional there is no finite price shift that offsets it, which is an error.
